purpose: Verify the D3.3 prereg's blocking pre-run items and its load-bearing premise BEFORE any wave launches.

tokenizer_asset.note: D3.3 states 'same vocab 4098'. It is 4096. IDs fit inside the model's 4098-row embedding so no resize is needed and 'embeddings unchanged' still holds, but the stated number was imprecise.

premise_check_context_fit.verdict: HOLDS — BPE takes 100% over-context to 0%. Compression 2.537x vs claimed 2.60x; the claim was measured on p1_screening_eval_v1 (150 rows), this on the training corpus (96 rows).

blocking_item_1_context_assertion.detail: integrity.assert_context_budget runs in run_startup_gate; raises on target-cannot-fit and on gold-span-lost-to-left-truncation; reports over-budget fraction into every run. Measured in tokens, not characters.

blocking_item_3_roundtrip.why: D3.2 decoded newlines to '?' and corrupted turn separators in 224/224 sources. That failure mode does not recur under this tokenizer.

blocking_item_2_bpb_floor.detail: The BPB floor (early 0.5 / late 0.01) was calibrated on char-level runs. It must be re-derived under BPE before it can gate anything. Requires running training under the new tokenizer, which requires the swap to be implemented behind a flag so the four frozen provenance classes stay reproducible.

remaining_to_launch: implement the BPE path behind a flag (char path untouched)
re-derive the BPB floor on the new instrument
caveat: D8 (no 1/sqrt(d) logit scaling) is OPEN and unfixed. It is common to every arm at a fixed width so it does not confound within-wave contrasts, but it does mean absolute BPB values are not comparable across model widths.
